items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: that was the week that Tunney beat Dempsey in Chicago.

ctx.x: There was a white promoter in Mississippi who thought enough of the band to buy two Chevrolet touring cars and turn them over to us for transportation. Now, he booked us all through Mississippi. And we played dances all through Mississippi. I mean we played Cleveland, Mississippi; Belzoni; many towns.

And in the meantime, we look in the newspaper, Chicago Defender, and we read where Fletcher Henderson was finishing his engagement at the Congress Hotel. And he was going to play a one night stand at the Chicago Armory that summer -- I can't think of the date, but it was during the same week that Dempsey fought Tunney -- that was before you was born, Doc.
Right. Do you remember the year?
